flags: The cache offers little road terrain, driving time, construction or designation-campaign history. Keep the overview shorter and describe the highway journey without inventing straight prairie miles or equating modern pavement with the exact mail trail.

Kansas Tourism’s directions contain Hwy 26 for Hwy 36 and several town-name typos. Use broad eastbound driving order from the consistent portions and material strip order. Exact turn instructions require correction before navigation use.

Kansas Tourism calls Marysville the only home station on its original site, while 01 calls Hollenberg a home station and says it has never moved. Cache 02 claims Hollenberg is the only surviving building, contrary to 00 and 03. Omit exclusivity rankings pending authoritative reconciliation.

Cache 01 gives 1858 in its lead but also c. 1857 or 1858 in its history; 00 supports a ranch beginning in 1858. Gerat in 01 differs from Geret in 02; use the station-specific form and flag the disagreement.

All current moments retained. Seneca is shorter than 90 words because the station-specific evidence is thin. Current draft’s Burton quotations and black squirrels are supported but omitted for focus, not rejected as false. No unsupported current claims were reused; home-station exclusivity was dropped as conflicting.

Hollenberg’s cached seasonal schedule is not from a current site-manager page, so no opening dates or dated access promises are supplied. Published 122 miles differs from material’s 123.4 mapped miles.
